name: seedlatch-web
description: Frontend for the Seedlatch exposure checker. Build-time dependencies only — nothing third-party is served to the browser.

scripts.//build: Deliberately NOT minified, and shipped with a sourcemap. See docs/toolchain.md: the JS toolchain is prebuilt binaries, so readability is what makes injection detectable without reproducing it. Requires web/pkg from wasm-pack.
scripts.//smoke: Both modules as separate entry points, NOT one importing the other. The interstitial only uses startOver from the guard, so bundling it alone tree-shakes guardField and with it the whole wasm-pack glue — the bundle got SMALLER and stopped exercising the thing this step exists to exercise. Entry-point exports are never tree-shaken, so listing both keeps the #core import live. Delete once build covers it.
